title: Problem with last modified  timestamp
body: It’s the good app with convenient features and a simple design—everything used to be great. However, for some reason, the developers removed the timestamp showing when notes were last modified. That timestamp used to help me recall when I’d made changes, but now it’s no longer displayed.
author: Fko9734
